request.text: While you keep looking at me, check whether frost is expected tonight, then tell me the result so I can decide whether to bring out the rabbit-hutch covers.

responsibilities.outcome: Look at the user and maintain that attention while the weather check is performed.
Check whether frost is forecast tonight and report the result after the lookup completes.

semantic_facts: The look-at-person action overlaps the frost lookup rather than being deferred until after it.
The frost result is reported only after the weather lookup, while deciding about or handling the rabbit-hutch covers remains with the user.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims to have brought out or installed the rabbit-hutch covers.
The concurrent attention requirement is discarded or converted into an unrelated blink or movement.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Explicit concurrency across embodied and informational Responsibilities is flattened into an incorrect serial order.
A stated purpose is mistaken for authorization to perform an additional garden task.
